environment.description: Same Ktor microservice deployed on hardened k3s cluster. Pod securityContext specifies drop: [ALL] with add: [NET_BIND_SERVICE] only. The container runtime is configured with a custom seccomp profile (audit-and-deny-timing.json) that intercepts clock_gettime, clock_nanosleep, and nanosleep syscalls by returning EPERM when called more than 50 times per second from the same thread group, effectively preventing timing-based side-channel measurements needed for padding oracle byte-by-byte recovery. Additionally, CAP_NET_RAW is dropped preventing raw socket timing measurements, and CAP_SYS_ADMIN removal prevents eBPF-based timing instrumentation. The Cilium network policy enforces per-source rate limiting of 3 requests/second to the /api/v1/session/validate endpoint with a token bucket of depth 5.

config.seccomp_profile: audit-and-deny-timing.json (custom: rate-limits clock_gettime/nanosleep syscalls to 50/sec/tgid, returns EPERM on excess)
config.network_policy: Cilium L7 policy with per-source rate limit 3 req/s, burst 5, on /api/v1/session/validate
